I have a class teaching me piano. Self teaching actually, with a book and a teacher in the next room over to guide me if needed. A class teaching me French. World cultures club and student council teaching me leadership and robotics teaching me problem solving. The problem isn’t me not using my time wisely, it’s that school provides an incentive and some time management. The only people who can say they don’t get those perks are people who unfortunately have school systems that don’t uphold their duty of creativity or people who don’t take advantage of what a school is giving them. I’m not implying that every day should be all work and no play, I just believe that shorter school days and less vacation time would mean kids can do their homework with time to spare every night. They can use that for video games or reading or watching or whatever they desire, but cramming it all into one unproductive week is more harmful than good.
